ticket_text: Hi, I can't find my debit card anywhere. Pretty sure I left it on the bus this morning. Can you cancel it and send me a new one? Regular shipping is fine.
hidden_facts: She has not seen any transactions she doesn't recognize.
She is fine paying the Basic replacement fee.
rationale: Lost card on Basic: report lost, order a standard replacement. The Basic replacement fee applies.

ticket_text: lost my card at a concert last night!! I fly out Friday so I need the new one fast. overnight it if you can
hidden_facts: He accepts the expedited shipping fee if told about it.

ticket_text: My wallet was stolen out of my car and my card was in it. Please cancel the card and get me a new one as fast as possible.

ticket_text: found my card in my jacket lol. you can unfreeze it now

rationale: Card is frozen at the member's request and was found: unfreeze.

ticket_text: My card says Locked by Tallowbrook. I didn't lock it! Please unlock it now, I'm at the grocery store trying to pay.
hidden_facts: There is no fraud alert showing in her app.
Yesterday she tried to buy concert tickets on a site she had never used.

ticket_text: There's a charge from VNTX*DIGITALGOODS for $64.99 on Aug 22 that I definitely didn't make. My card is still in my wallet.
hidden_facts: He has never bought anything from that merchant.
He agrees to freezing the card if asked, but doesn't want a replacement today.

ticket_text: I just noticed a charge from June 12, $120 at Volta Electronics. I don't know what it is. Can you dispute it?
hidden_facts: If offered, she doesn't want her card frozen or replaced. She thinks her son may have used it.

ticket_text: Hey, I see a charge of $340 from Lumen Outfitters London on July 25. I haven't been to the UK in years. Please dispute it.
hidden_facts: His card is at home in his desk drawer.
He agrees to freezing the card if asked, but doesn't want a replacement.

ticket_text: I ordered a lamp from Willowmade Goods on June 5th for $89.50 and it never showed up. They stopped answering my emails. Can you get my money back?
hidden_facts: She emailed the merchant three times, last on August 30.
She has the order confirmation with an expected delivery date of June 20.

ticket_text: I want to dispute a $210 charge from Orbital Home Decor from back in April, the rug they sent is nothing like the photos.
hidden_facts: The purchase was on April 20.
He contacted the merchant in May and they refused a return.

ticket_text: Two charges I did NOT make: Aurora Jewelers $4,200 on Sep 3 and Skyline Electronics $2,600 on Sep 4. Please fix this immediately.
hidden_facts: Her card is in her purse.
She agrees to freezing the card if asked.
She recently used the card on a travel booking site.

ticket_text: There's a charge from Ember Pizza for $45 but I only spent $38. Dispute it please.
hidden_facts: He paid $38 by card and left the tip in cash.
He hasn't checked whether the charge is still pending.
rationale: The transaction is pending and can't be disputed. Restaurant authorizations often include an estimated tip. Explain and wait.

ticket_text: I need to dispute the Brightcart charge from August 10, they never sent my order.
hidden_facts: She opened a dispute in the app on August 20 and forgot.
rationale: An open dispute already exists for this transaction. Point her to it rather than opening another.

ticket_text: Pinecone Grocery charged me twice on Sep 2, $54.20 both times. The store says it's the bank's problem, not theirs.
hidden_facts: He only shopped there once that day.
The store manager refused to refund and told him to call his bank.
rationale: Both charges posted, merchant contacted and refused. Dispute the second charge as a duplicate. The card doesn't need freezing.

ticket_text: The ATM on 5th street didn't give me any cash but my account shows a $200 withdrawal on Sep 9. What do I do?
hidden_facts: She kept the ATM receipt, which shows an error code.
The ATM was ATM 22 FIFTH ST.

ticket_text: I cancelled StreamNest back in July but they charged me again in August and now again this month. Can you get those back?
hidden_facts: He cancelled on July 20 and has the confirmation email.
He emailed StreamNest twice and got no reply.

ticket_text: Hi! I used an ATM that wasn't BrookLink on Sep 5 and got charged a fee. Any chance you could refund it? First time it's happened.
hidden_facts: She hasn't had a fee refunded before.
rationale: Basic out-of-network fee was charged correctly. Eligible for the one goodwill refund per 12 months, under the goodwill maximum.

ticket_text: Can you refund the foreign transaction fee from my Lisbon trip? It's small but it adds up.
hidden_facts: He remembers support refunded an ATM fee for him in the spring.
rationale: The FX fee was charged correctly on Plus, and he already used his goodwill refund on 2026-04-02, less than 12 months ago. Politely decline.

ticket_text: Please refund the international wire fee from Sep 4. $35 is a lot for one transfer.
hidden_facts: She hasn't had any fee refunded before.
rationale: The fee was charged correctly and is above the goodwill maximum per fee. Decline.

ticket_text: I'm on Premium, why did I get charged an out-of-network ATM fee on Sep 10??
hidden_facts: He used an ATM at a gas station, not a BrookLink one.
rationale: Premium has no out-of-network ATM fee, so the fee was charged in error. Error refunds are always allowed.

ticket_text: I got charged $5 for my replacement card in August but I'm on Plus and I thought replacements were free?
hidden_facts: She has been on Plus since before the card was lost.
rationale: Plus replacements are free. The fee was charged in error, so refund it as an error.

ticket_text: I upgraded to Plus last week but honestly it's not worth it for me. Can you cancel it and give me my money back?
hidden_facts: This is the first time he has ever been on a paid plan.
rationale: First paid plan charge was 9 days ago, inside the 14-day cooling-off period. Refund it and move to Basic right away.

ticket_text: Please downgrade me to Plus and refund this month's Premium fee, I barely used any of the perks.
hidden_facts: He has been on Premium for more than a year.
rationale: Downgrade takes effect on the next billing date. Plan fees aren't prorated or eligible for goodwill, and the cooling-off period doesn't apply. Downgrade only.

ticket_text: hey can you switch me to Plus? want the higher savings rate
hidden_facts: She understands the monthly fee is charged today.

ticket_text: I want to cancel my plan.
hidden_facts: She wants to move to the free plan, not close her account.

ticket_text: Switch me to the better plan
hidden_facts: He means Premium. He wants the metal card and no foreign fees for a trip.

ticket_text: Please close my Tallowbrook account. I've already moved all my money out.

rationale: Balance isn't zero, so support can't close it. Explain that he can close it in the app, which sends the remaining balance, or move the money out first.

ticket_text: Close my account, I'm done with this bank.

ticket_text: Close it.

He moved his money out last week and has nothing pending.

ticket_text: I just got an email saying my password was changed and I DIDN'T do that. There's also a BrookPay payment for $480 to someone called jaxon_r22 that I never sent. Help!

hidden_facts: She found the seller on a social media marketplace.
She sent the payment herself.

ticket_text: Hi, this is Delphine's husband Marc. She's traveling and asked me to check if her paycheck came in and move $500 to our joint account at another bank.
hidden_facts: He is using her phone, which was left at home.
He has no power of attorney.

She is messaging from her father's signed-in app with his permission.

ticket_text: I got married last month. Please change my last name to Faraday-Nakamura.

ticket_text: Why can't I send money?? My account says under review. Please remove that, I need to pay rent.

hidden_facts: Her bag was stolen from a cafe yesterday with the card in it.
